_meta.description: ملف شامل مدمج — كل أسهم كل الأسواق + weights + audit + sources

metadata.important_notice: This file is a verified starter dataset and source/audit manifest, NOT a complete constituents-and-weights database for all indices in all five markets. Missing data is explicitly marked rather than guessed.
metadata.weight_definition: Percentage weight of a constituent within the specified index.
rules: A stock can appear in multiple index records, with a separate weight for each index.
Do not treat null weights as zero.
Do not infer current membership from a symbol list alone.
Verify each index's official methodology and effective date before production use.

required_next_steps: Inventory official benchmark, sector, capped, and other active EGX indices.
Collect each index constituent list and official weight data where published.
Record effective dates and distinguish official weights from calculated estimates.

market_sources_and_coverage.source_notes: Saudi Exchange describes an Index Weightage Report with constituent weights in TASI.
required_next_steps: Inventory relevant broad-market, sector, and other active indices.
Obtain official constituent/weightage reports and their effective dates.
Inventory active Premier, Main, sector, and other relevant indices.
Collect constituents and official weights for each index.

market_sources_and_coverage.source_notes: QSE publishes constituent pages and review notices. A separate Al Rayan ETF page lists index holdings and weights effective 2026-09-01.
required_next_steps: Collect the latest official constituent and weighting files for QE Index, QE All Share, sector indices, and QE Al Rayan Islamic Index.
Cross-check the Al Rayan holdings below against the latest official QSE notice.

market_sources_and_coverage.source_notes: US is not one index. The project must explicitly define which index families to include (for example S&P 500, Nasdaq-100, Dow Jones, Russell, NYSE indices). Full constituent weights may require licensed data or official provider downloads.
required_next_steps: Confirm the project's intended US index universe.
Collect index-by-index constituents, weights, effective dates, and licensing/source metadata.

known_gaps: EGX index universe and constituents/weights not collected.
TADAWUL index universe and full constituents/weights not collected.
KSE index universe and constituents/weights not collected.
QSE coverage is only partial; other index constituents and weights are missing.
US coverage is only partial; S&P 500 top constituents are listed but individual weights and the remaining constituents are missing.
Some QSE ticker symbols should be validated against the exchange's current security master before production use.
